description: This file defines the MembershipSystemTarget class, which implements IMembershipService and ILifecycleParticipant. It handles membership-related operations such as pinging silos, processing membership change notifications, conducting gossip communication between silos, and managing membership table updates within the Orleans distributed system framework.

classes.name: MembershipSystemTarget
classes.description: A system target class that manages membership operations, including pinging silos, processing membership updates, handling gossip protocols, and interacting with the membership table in the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a simple ping operation, signaling that this system target is active.

methods.name: MembershipChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles incoming membership change notifications, updating the membership table or reading it in case of minimal version.

methods.name: ProbeRemoteSilo
methods.description: Sends a ping to a specified remote silo to check its health.

methods.name: ProbeRemoteSiloIndirectly
methods.description: Conducts an indirect health probe of a remote silo via an intermediary, with timeout handling.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs the actual indirect probe, managing response time and exceptions.

methods.name: GossipToRemoteSilos
methods.description: Gossips membership information to a list of remote silos.

methods.name: GossipToRemoteSilo
methods.description: Sends membership update gossip to a specific remote silo.

methods.name: ReadTable
methods.description: Refreshes the membership table from its source.

methods.name: ProbeInternal
methods.description: Internal method to send a ping to a remote silo and update metrics.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements the ILifecycleParticipant interface; no specific logic, just for lifecycle registration.
